svg.title: Trinity Rise · Four-bedroom apartment, Option B — schematic exploration v1
svg.desc: The same 56-ft by 26-ft envelope as Option A, re-planned so every bedroom has its own ensuite bathroom. Tests what the premium 'bed-bath parity' feature costs in space and fixtures. 4 beds. Envelope 56'-0" by 26'-0" (1456 sf) using exploratory dimensions. Not measured, not code reviewed, not for construction.
svg.text: Trinity Rise · Four-bedroom apartment, Option B
Four private bedrooms, each with an ensuite bathroom
4 beds · envelope 56'-0" × 26'-0" = 1,456 sf · 364 sf per bed
SCHEMATIC EXPLORATION · v1 · 2026-11-06 · Dimensions are exploratory assumptions (studies/assumptions.json), not measurements.
Not code-reviewed, not an accessibility determination, not for construction. Orientation not established (no north arrow).
Independent student design study by Ivan Minier, drawn with AI assistance. Not a UVM design or an adopted part of the Trinity Redistricting proposal.
